digest.component_or_area: code-health metrics derivation from git history
propositions: Four read-only, deterministic metric functions must derive code-health data from git history and the working tree: module-size distribution against a single flat cap, cap-change events, churn totals, and refactor-to-addition ratio.

Each raw metric function accepts multi-argument inputs (repo_root, ref or time range) and is wrapped in a single-arg context adapter for registration into the c085 MetricSpec registry with lens='code_health', source='git', confidence='high'.
The module-size cap is single-sourced from .github/module-size-limit.txt (no per-file allowlist or ratchet); distribution scans src/rebar/**/*.py line counts at a given ref against that cap.

churn and refactor_to_addition_ratio derive from git log --numstat over a time range; cap_change_events surfaces commits that altered .github/module-size-limit.txt; a range with no data returns None or empty list, never raises.
